pages.text: 小兔子准备睡觉，可是牙齿还亮着光
pages.imagePrompt: a sleepy rabbit holding a toothbrush beside a cozy bed
pages.interactionHint: 拍拍小兔子的头，然后帮它挤牙膏

pages.text: 它挤出泡泡，牙刷在太阳花杯子里转圈圈
pages.imagePrompt: a rabbit brushing its teeth with sparkling bubbles around
pages.interactionHint: 数一数泡泡，看看有几个

pages.text: 每个牙齿都有朋友来打招呼，刷呀刷呀
pages.imagePrompt: cute teeth characters waving while being brushed

pages.text: 牙齿亮晶晶，小兔子抱枕睡得香香
pages.imagePrompt: rabbit snuggled under blankets with sparkling teeth
pages.interactionHint: 说一声晚安，吹个小睡吻

pages.text: 今晚月亮觉得自己亮得太孤单
pages.imagePrompt: gentle moon looking thoughtful over a sleepy village

pages.text: 它召唤小星星们来跳舞，一起照亮山谷
pages.imagePrompt: moon sending sparkling stars dancing above mountains

pages.text: 孩子们收到星星的礼物，心里暖洋洋
pages.imagePrompt: children catching glowing star lanterns in hands

pages.text: 小狮子发现朋友跑去森林尽头，不敢跟过去
pages.imagePrompt: young lion peeking into dark forest with worried eyes
pages.interactionHint: 拍拍小狮子的背，鼓励它

pages.text: 它记起勇敢的故事，决定迈开大步
pages.imagePrompt: lion taking confident steps through tall grass

pages.text: 风里传来朋友的呼喊，勇气让它冲出去
pages.imagePrompt: forest clearing with lion roaring joyfully
